rationale: Proposes converting BRL to 450,000 USD via the approved bank_fx rail with FX-PROV-01 to address BrazilCo's projected USD liquidity gap. This amount is within the 500,000 USD policy cap and leaves more than 2,000,000 BRL in BrazilCo's BRL accounts post-conversion. Human approval is required as the transaction exceeds the 100,000 USD threshold.
